scope: Source-only integration of released Gamma, strategies, backtesting, agents, providers, knowledge and concrete adapters packages; companion native market-data and gateway package manifests
authority: User-authorized first-party Gamma reuse. source-files.json retains the original pure-slice source identities unchanged. released-source.json merges author release receipts, report lineage, exclusions and separate original-source versus current local destination identities; no clean-HEAD or runtime-parity assumption.
observedSourceBehavior: All six feature compute signatures, formulas, labels, thresholds, sorting, missing-value rules and native model fields are preserved after options_alpha-to-gamma import relocation.

SetupEngine identify_setup signature, seven weighted components, accepted/rejected output, ordered rejection trail, 49-point rejected cap, confidence=round(score/100,4), strategy preferences and stable legacy setup ID are preserved.
Momentum compares whole supplied-window returns against the last equally sized benchmark window; 20/50-bar breakouts permit shorter histories. No trading-session reindexing is added.
Market structure value area remains a rounded close-distribution approximation. atr_percent remains mean(high-low)/latest_close*100, not true-range ATR.
Liquidity missing per-contract OI/volume/spread can pass native thresholds; ticker totals only replace zero contract sums. This is not quote readiness or authorization.
Fundamental nonnegative company fields clamp at zero; employee count truncates; signed changes and surprise thresholds are retained.

Option flow provider totals override contract sums; zero put premium yields a missing derived ratio; expired contracts remain in the source short-dated bucket. Its output as_of remains a date, not an intraday timestamp.

Source pure computations use supplied snapshots and contain no implicit wall clock/provider fetch. Internal SetupEngine may infer reference time from supplied snapshots; the adapter always passes explicit as_of.

Legacy setup ID omits reference time/configuration. It is preserved for characterization, not promoted to a public immutable artifact identity. Adapter identity additionally binds module, explicit cutoff, input source hashes, observation/availability metadata and native output digest.

intentionalAdaptations.change: The first pure slice extracted StrategyType, OptionContractFlow and OptionFlowSnapshot. QuantGammaBuild-v1 replaces that local extraction with the full source-backed internal options schema and adds the portfolio schema, selector and committee. Signals still retains MarketStructureSnapshot, VolatilitySnapshot and TradeSetup only. Original source hashes remain unchanged; previous local extraction hashes are historical identities in released-source.json. Internal models are not public Vertex schemas or execution authority.

SetupEngine America/New_York timezone is loaded from the exact pinned tzdata 2026.2 package resource instead of mutable host TZPATH. Holiday calculations, weekend grace and fixed 16:15 daily-bar availability algorithm are unchanged.
intentionalAdaptations.limitations: Not a validated exchange calendar: early closes, historical holiday applicability, extraordinary closures, settlement and instrument-specific schedules remain absent. The early-close test deliberately characterizes the limitation. No 0DTE readiness.

intentionalAdaptations.area: native adapter cutoff and data binding
intentionalAdaptations.change: InputArtifact requires bounded immutable UTF-8 JSON bytes, matching source SHA-256, aware observed_at and available_at. Availability after explicit reference cutoff, future embedded observation metadata and future bar dates fail closed, rather than silently filtering. Volatility aliases are checked with the actual kernel ISO parser as well as the boundary precision checks, and the resulting as_of is rechecked before publication; compact ISO dates are not mistaken for epoch strings. Date-only bars retain native UTC date-label semantics and require caller-declared whole-snapshot availability.
intentionalAdaptations.limitations: Metadata is asserted by the caller, not provider attestation or entitlement proof. This boundary cannot infer unstated publication/vintage times or validate arbitrary opaque provider-specific fields. No real provider normalization is claimed.

intentionalAdaptations.change: Future scheduled earnings dates are allowed. Realized earnings surprise/actual-EPS fields are checked against the full aware intraday instant and offset when supplied; only date-only events use the UTC date plus caller-declared whole-snapshot envelope semantics. This applies both to fundamental computation and identify_setup raw fundamentals. Precomputed fundamental features still require honest whole-snapshot observation/availability metadata; the original native compute remains unchanged.

No feature/scoring numerical formula adaptation. Native Python floats and microsecond datetimes remain internal. Boundary rejects nonfinite decoded numbers, nonfinite coerced native-model fields and numeric-string NaN/Infinity in recognized consumed raw numeric fields before unchanged kernels can clamp or discard them. Unrelated free text is not treated as numeric data; native handling of ordinary malformed/missing numeric values is retained. Duplicate JSON keys, unsupported graphs, naive intraday timestamps and submicrosecond strings are rejected rather than presented as Vertex wire compliance. Date-only labels and native epoch seconds/milliseconds retain source semantics except the distinct documented volatility ISO parser.

Detached output maps recursively become MappingProxyType; lists become tuples; native scalar/date/datetime types are retained. Every frozen datetime leaf and all receipt/reference metadata are reconstructed as plain UTC datetimes, preventing caller-owned mutable tzinfo or datetime-subclass state from changing an already-hashed identity. Source-compatible native JSON bytes remain separate from this normalized native graph. Input bytes and artifact receipts use frozen slotted dataclasses. Caller inputs are not frozen or retained by reference. Setup boundary checks ticker consistency and nested evidence cutoffs. Missing chain still returns rejected setup, not an empty success.

For volatility without embedded observation time, explicit envelope observed_at is used, never the reference cutoff. Liquidity adapter labels its composite with latest supplied observation horizon; each input's individual observation and availability remain in identity metadata. Native compute timestamp precedence is otherwise preserved.

Selector/committee, guarded decimal projection and ResearchEvidence planning are authored; five research sleeves, separately blocked 0DTE, causal supplied-outcome replay, simulation planning and event-study timing/statistics are authored. Advisory agents use bounded injected ports and immutable original evidence plus a fresh exact-scoped AcceptedReview overlay from QuantAgentsBuild-v2; v3 adds exact research|paper|live advisory environment support without coercion or order authority. Allocation is not a reservation; replay is not simulated economics; model output never grants authority.
intentionalAdaptations.lineage: released-source.json retains each author's report IDs, original-source receipts, adaptations, exclusions and acceptance limitations.

intentionalAdaptations.change: Provider request/normalization boundaries, immutable datasets, named-collection knowledge ingestion/retrieval plans, market-data normalization and gateway readiness/human-recovery boundaries are authored. Released adapters add explicit TLS transport, single-host budget admission, independently current model-use proof, scoped review/publication composition, bounded decoder workers and optional Agno/Arrow/PDF boundaries. Licensed input, current rights, authoritative codec/validator/time and durable stores remain explicit host ports. No provider request, model call, ingestion, gateway recovery or native runtime execution is claimed.
intentionalAdaptations.limitations: Gateway remains a native service library, not a second REST service or BFF. Market-data and control-client depend on the exact local vertex-gamma-research distribution; research adapters lazily consume both companion packages under host composition, not hidden public-registry resolution. Host binds services/contracts/python/src/vertex_contracts authority. Optional adapter SDK exact versions remain proposals without approved artifact/transitive locks; vLLM is a separately pinned remote service, not a research dependency.
